subject: Oakridge RFI: technical handoff & evidence window
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@oakridge.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@oakridge.com
Date: 2029-04-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Oakridge RFI kickoff and timeline request

Jonas,

Thanks for the intro via procurement — attaching Oakridge's RFI matrix for the SIG/SOC2 section (see attachment: Oakridge_RFI_Matrix_v1.xlsx). We need a short technical handoff so our security and procurement teams can map controls and lock an evidence window.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm whether Redwood can commit to a 30-day evidence window starting 2029-04-22.
- Provide a control mapping (SIG->Redwood control IDs) and samples of supporting artifacts (SOC 2 report, key rotation logs, sample telemetry).
- Preferred upload method for artifacts (we prefer a secure Drive folder or SFTP pickup).

Can we schedule a 30-minute handoff this week? Daniel Park from Oakridge's security team will join for technical clarifications.

Best,
Karen Li
Senior Procurement Manager
Oakridge Capital

Attachments: Oakridge_RFI_Matrix_v1.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@oakridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@oakridge.com
Date: 2029-04-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge RFI kickoff and timeline request

Karen — thanks for sending this over. We can support the RFI and the evidence window you propose.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Technical handoff call: 2029-04-15 10:00 AM PT (30 min). I'll lead the mapping overview; Kimberly will cover SOC 2/ISO artifacts and Marissa will coordinate evidence delivery.
2) I attached our control-map template (redwood_control_map_template.xlsx) — please populate the Oakridge columns where you have internal traceability IDs; we'll fill the Redwood control references during the handoff.
3) Artifact drop: we will provision a shared, access-controlled Google Drive folder for Oakridge (link below) and also provide a signed SFTP token if you prefer programmatic ingestion. For small samples (logs, PDFs) Drive is easiest.

Requested items from Oakridge before the call:
- Any priority controls you want us to demonstrate during the window (e.g., KMS, key rotation, telemetry retention).
- Whether you need raw telemetry samples or redacted aggregates.

I note one potential exception: our hosted telemetry retention for debug traces is 90 days by default; if you need longer retention for the evidence window we can export historic aggregates as a one-time snapshot. We'll discuss on the call.

Drive folder (provisioned): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOakridge-RFI
DocuSign link for non-disclosure (if needed): https://www.docusign.com/link/oaKridgN-nda

Attachments: redwood_control_map_template.xlsx

—
Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Assurance
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0199

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-13T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Oakridge RFI — roles & evidence plan (prep for 4/15)

Team — quick prep notes ahead of the 4/15 handoff: 

Marissa: you'll own artifacts orchestration (who uploads what and redaction checklist). Please prepare:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and the control testing index (page refs).
- Sample S3 audit log extract (we'll export a week of entries and redact tenant IDs) — see attachment stub: redwood_s3_audit_log_sample.pdf.

Kimberly: cover ISO 27001 scopes and any mapping differences (our private deployment options require a different control mapping).

Operational notes:
- Evidence window start: Oakridge asked for 2029-04-22 through 2029-05-22 (30 days) — confirm on call.
- Custodian mapping: we should propose owners for each control bucket so they can request artifacts directly (e.g., KMS: Infrastructure Security; Telemetry: Runtime Engineering).
- Redaction guidance: we will offer a template redaction rule set (PII/tenant id removal) and a checksum for each artifact to show integrity.

I'll run the handoff and cover the control mapping approach. Please add any items to the shared Drive before the call.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachments referenced: redwood_s3_audit_log_sample.pdf

From: Daniel Park - Oakridge IT Security <dan.park@oakridge.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karen Li <karen.li@oakridge.com>
Cc: procurement@oakridge.com
Date: 2029-04-15T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge RFI kickoff and timeline request

Jonas/Karen — thanks for the quick response and the Drive link. A few clarifications from security before we proceed: 

- Access model: we will create a limited-access account for reviewers; prefer Google Drive with enforced 2FA and time-limited access. SFTP tokens are acceptable if they are single-use and delivered over a secure channel.
- Evidence fidelity: for telemetry we need 24-hour timestamp accuracy and examples of cache/KV accesses for model serving (to validate isolation guarantees). If raw traces include tenant IDs, we request redacted copies plus a manifest describing redaction rules.
- Sampling window: we typically validate a 7-day contiguous sample during our 30-day evidence window. Please confirm you can produce that.

We do not require a new NDA at this time provided the Drive access is logged and limited to named reviewers. If anything changes, we'll sign the DocuSign.

Regards,
Daniel Park
Lead, IT Security
Oakridge Capital

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <dan.park@oakridge.com>, Karen Li <karen.li@oakridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@oakridge.com
Date: 2029-04-17T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge RFI kickoff and timeline request — confirmation and delivery plan

Daniel/Karen — confirmed. Summary & commitments: 

1) Evidence window: Oakridge requested 2029-04-22 through 2029-05-22 (30 days). We'll prepare a 7-day high-fidelity telemetry sample inside that window for validation.
2) Access: we'll grant named Drive access with enforced 2FA and time-limited links. All access events will be logged and provided as part of the artifact manifest.
3) Artifacts to be uploaded by 2029-04-21 (one business day before window start):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
   - Control mapping workbook (completed redwood_control_map_template.xlsx)
   - 7-day telemetry sample (redacted per manifest)
   - KMS key rotation proof and metadata (rotation timestamps, key IDs)
   - S3 audit log extract (redacted)

4) Redaction & integrity: Marissa will provide the redaction checklist and SHA256 checksums for each uploaded artifact. We'll include a short manifest that documents redaction rules applied to each file.

Drive link (same as provisioning): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOakridge-RFI
If you prefer SFTP for larger archives, we will share a single-use token the morning of 2029-04-21.

If this plan looks good, we'll treat the 4/15 call as the kickoff and proceed to upload on 4/21. If Oakridge needs an earlier sample ahead of the window, let us know and Marissa will prioritize.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth validation.

—
Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Assurance
Redwood Inference
Attachments (to be uploaded): SOC2_TypeII_2028.pdf (PDF), control_map_completed.xlsx (Excel), redwood_s3_audit_log_sample.pdf (PDF)
